create_MCPServer: create an MCPServer instance with transport, auth type, and optional OAuth or AWS SigV4 credentials
build_MCPOAuthMetadata: build an MCPOAuthMetadata object with scopes, authorization_url, token_url, and registration_url
test_MCPServer_has_client_credentials: test whether an MCPServer uses OAuth2 client_credentials (M2M) flow
review_MCPServer_requires_per_user_auth: review whether an MCPServer requires per-user authentication or auth header passthrough
summarize_MCPServer_needs_user_oauth_tok: summarize if an MCPServer needs per-user OAuth tokens without client credentials
